title: Site Director – Data Center Operations
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Director of Construction PMO is an onsite leader responsible for managing all operations at one of our large data center project sites. Based full-time at the site, this role leads project delivery, field execution, governance, resource management, performance reporting, and risk management to ensure work is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Director partners with the Regional Director, Project Managers, Field Leadership, Estimators, the general contractor, trade partners, and the client’s onsite team to drive operational excellence and consistent project outcomes.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage all onsite operations at the data center site, serving as the senior company leader on site.
* Be present in the field daily, walking the site to monitor progress, workmanship, safety, and quality.
* Establish and enforce site-level PMO standards, governance, project controls, documentation, and closeout procedures.
* Oversee multiple project teams, scopes, and phases on site, monitoring schedule, financial health, risk exposure, and resource allocation.
* Lead daily and weekly site coordination meetings with project teams, field leadership, the general contractor, trades, and the client.
* Coordinate closely with the client’s onsite representatives, general contractor, and other trades to resolve issues and keep work moving.
* Plan and adjust onsite manpower, equipment, and materials to meet schedule demands; develop workforce and resource forecasts.
* Own site safety performance, ensuring compliance with company safety standards, site-specific requirements, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Drive quality through QA/QC processes, inspections, testing, and punch list and closeout management.
* Partner with Operations and Finance to manage site budgets, forecasts, earned value, change orders, cash flow, and margin.

title: Director, Grid Connections
description: Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara. We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure. By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future. Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe. THE PROBLEM YOU’LL HELP SOLVE Utilities are contending with a rapidly shifting energy mix and a surge in connection requests, from renewable generation to hyperscale data centre campuses. Together, these pressures are testing the long-term reliability and resilience of critical infrastructure networks. Until now, utilities have had to manage these challenges by making conservative assumptions drawn from siloed data. Neara acquired Zepben to solve this problem. By combining electrical, physical and risk modelling, we’ve created the world’s first integrated digital twin, giving utilities a single model in which to assess physical and electrical constraints together. The result is faster connections, more clean energy on the grid, real progress towards decarbonisation targets and downward pressure on power prices. title: Strategic Category Lead
description:
Gradian is an engineering-led, full-line thermal solutions partner serving data center and other mission-critical, commercial, and industrial markets. Headquartered in Maple Grove, MN, with additional facilities across North America, we design and manufacture liquid cooling systems, air handling equipment, heat rejection units, and modular, factory-assembled thermal management solutions.

Gradian was founded through the unification of four complementary, established brands: MAS HVAC, Daedex, DeepCoolAI, and EcoChillers. Together, we act as a single-source provider, deploying cooling technologies as scalable systems optimized for efficiency, spatial constraints, and overall performance. With a vertically integrated engineering and manufacturing model, we pair rapid design turnaround with precision fabrication, so customers can move faster on complex projects where reliability, timeline, and quality all matter.

**Why work here**

At Gradian, you'll work alongside others who get genuinely fired up by complex problems, see your work go from first sketch to job site in weeks, not years, and know that while we're developing the technologies critical for AI infrastructure to scale, our culture remains people-first by design.

It is core to our identity that we operate as one team — driving to win together, energizing others, and building lasting relationships that make the work fun and rewarding.

**Position Summary:**

The Strategic Category Lead - Data Center Liquid Cooling is responsible for developing and executing category strategies for critical components supporting Gradian's growing liquid cooling business. This strategic individual contributor will build deep market and supplier knowledge, develop strategic supplier relationships, and drive long-term value across cost, quality, technology, capacity, and supply chain resiliency. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to align category and supplier strategies
